I am requesting that https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/64#issuecomment-1633600634 be reconsidered as this is now a control of MVSP after the former [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/64) was closed and [subsequent thread on Slack](https://owasp.slack.com/archives/C06MNF14M/p1689228459334399).

["2.3 Security Headers" of MVSP](https://github.com/vendorsec/mvsp/blame/master/packages/mvsp/mvsp.en.asciidoc#L68-L72) is reproduced below:

`2.3 Security Headers`
`Apply appropriate security headers to reduce the application attack surface and limit post exploitation:`
` `
`  * Set a minimally permissive Content Security Policy`
`  * Limit the ability to iframe sensitive application content where appropriate`

The parent of this [MVSP] issue is https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1151 and associated GitHub Discussion is https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/discussions/1690

Reproduction of [Slack thread](https://owasp.slack.com/archives/C06MNF14M/p1689228459334399)
